newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN HANSAPANK HAS FRANKFURT LISTING.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN HANSAPANK HAS FRANKFURT LISTING.

text.p: Leading Estonian commercial bank Hansapank said on Tuesday it obtained a listing last month on the over-the-counter free market of the Frankfurt stock exchange.
"Starting from October 23, 1996 Hansapank's shares are listed on one of the largest stock exchanges, Frankfurt Stock Exchange's free market," the bank said in a statement.
A Hansapank spokesman said the announcement of the listing had been delayed because the bank had only now been informed that Ballmaier and Schultz had agreed to be its market maker in Germany.
Before the Frankfurt listing, Hansapank was listed on the Tallinn stock exchange and the Helsinki Brokers' list.
